messages:
Ayesha (PM): Hey team — final check on the annual planning offsite next Wed/Thu. We need: venue confirmation, facilitator runbook, breakout owners, prework assignments, and AV checklist. Can we lock owners today?

Liam - Eng: I can own the breakout on runtime / infra tradeoffs. Will prepare a 15m tech constraints slide + Qs.

Sofia (Design): I'll own the product direction breakout. Also can do a short design critique lightning demo. Need a projector for that.

Rita (People Ops): Venue options: The Loft (downtown) and Harbor Room. Loft has in-house A/V but smaller. Harbor needs external AV vendor. Catering: need dietary RSVP by Monday. I can create the invite + RSVP form.

Carlos (Staff Eng): For facilitation, recommend we rotate facilitators across sessions so PMs don't have to run all of it. I can facilitate the canary/rollback policy discussion.

Maya - Research: I'll curate the customer signal deck and three 5-min case studies. Can we agree on the success criteria for each initiative (OKR-aligned)?

Ayesha (PM): Yes — owners should list launch criteria (1 primary metric + 2 guardrails) in prework. Use this template:
```
Initiative: 
Owner: 
Primary success metric: 
Guardrails: 
Required infra changes (yes/no): 
Launch blockers: 
```
Please post in the #product-docs thread by EOD Monday.

Liam - Eng: Quick Q — do we want a dry-run for the infra session? Might help smooth demos.

Carlos (Staff Eng): +1 dry-run. Suggest 30m rehearsal the day before for owners presenting demos.

Rita (People Ops): Noted. I'll block a 90min slot before the offsite for rehearsals and tech check. Also collecting dietary restrictions now.

offsites-bot: Calendar invite created: "Redwood Annual Planning Offsite — Wed/Thu" — RSVP form link: https://rwd.co/offsite-rsvp

Sofia (Design): For breakout rooms — can we split Product direction by customer segment? (Startup / Mid-market / Enterprise). I can lead the enterprise strand.

Ayesha (PM): Good idea. Owners so far: Product direction (Sofia), Runtime/Infra (Liam), Canaries & Rollbacks (Carlos), Customer signals (Maya). Still need owner for Pricing & Packaging session. Anyone volunteer?

Liam - Eng: I can help prep a slide on cost sensitivity but not lead pricing.

Maya - Research: I can pull pricing research but need someone to lead the actual session.

Ayesha (PM): @Rita — can you confirm which venue wins by end of day? Also we'll need name badges, 2 whiteboards, and sticky notes.

Rita (People Ops): I'll confirm the Loft if it fits the headcount (60). Harbor is cheaper but AV fee + travel for vendor. I'll update by 6pm.

Carlos (Staff Eng): One last ops note: please list any interactive tooling you need (Zoom room, laptop HDMI adapters, dongles) in the doc. I'll bring an extra USB-C hub.

Ayesha (PM): Perfect — last item: post your prework links and the short template into #product-docs. I'll compile into a single runbook and share a 2-page facilitator cheatsheet. Thanks all! :rocket:
